scoring.formula: score = solved_levels; rank by score descending, then total_tokens ascending
scoring.time_policy: Agent wall time is retained only as a diagnostic and does not affect the score because it is sensitive to service stability.
scoring.ordering_guarantee: Each solved puzzle contributes exactly one point. Token use only breaks ties between trials with the same integer score.
scoring.eligibility_policy: A valid verifier result retains its integer score even when token accounting is unavailable. Such a trial is excluded only from token-based tie ranking. Reaching the configured Agent timeout is an expected benchmark cutoff and retains the verified score; other infrastructure exceptions invalidate the score itself.
scoring.continuation_policy: Ordered continuation segments must share task, checksum, model, and reasoning effort, and cumulative scores may not decrease. The chain score is the final cumulative score; tokens are summed across every segment.

raw.token_accounting: input_tokens + output_tokens; cache_tokens is a subset of input_tokens and is not added again
